name: Microgrid external dispatch request boundary

summary: Identifies the documented interface receiving an external site power request.
description: Identifies the documented interface receiving an external site power request. Microgrid supervision coordinates measurements, control authority and resource communication without replacing local protection. Each resource value needs a named measurement boundary, freshness condition and intended control use.

In a microgrid control room, the operator can see source availability, active constraints and current operating mode. A communication failure should remain distinguishable from an electrical resource failure. For this reference, the drawing identifies “External dispatch message” at the input and “Site dispatch request” at the output. The request is subject to site authority and limits.
